Messages.Author: puslemus
Messages.Body:
What multipliers are Orlandos text referring to? I can play bewitching oration, awe etc, right, since it only limits Hall of Hades` Court, right?

I am trying to build something with Bela, Orlando, and voter cap but they share only dom ... :(

Orlando Oriundus, 9, obf AUS DOM THA, Tremere Antitribu, 4, [Third:V]
Sabbat bishop: During a referendum, if Orlando is ready, your vampires` votes are doubled when votes are tallied, and other multipliers may not be played on your vampires. +1 bleed.

Bela Kardoza, 10, ani dom CEL POT PRE VIC, Brujah Antitribu, 4, [Third:V]
Sabbat: During a referendum, Bela may burn X blood to get X additional votes.

Do you think the combination of their special abilities is strong enough to disregard the lack of discipline synergy?

Messages.Author: jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
I just like using Orlando and obfuscate weenies who get quick Crusades.
That has worked for me.
And you can always fall back on Orlando's DOM/obf/+1-bleed if all else fails.

Orlando with Mob Rule is also a fun combo.
I've found that when I play it, the other Methuselahs just decide not to do the math, so I don't have to burn more than 1-2 blood (usually none) and they let my vote pass.
When playing it as a reaction, doubled Mob Rule is pretty awesome vote *defense*, as well.
